# Smart Billing Lite — Full AI-readable Site Reference

## Identity
- Name: Smart Billing Lite
- Product: Mobile-first billing and small-business management application with Android APK and accompanying marketing website.
- Service Area: India (explicitly stated in the About page content).

## Short description
Smart Billing Lite is an AI-powered mobile billing app for small businesses that supports quick invoice creation, QR/UPI payments, thermal printing, udhaar (credit) tracking, and daily business reporting.

## Core features (from site content)
- Super-fast billing with item-based entries and calculator-like UI.
- QR & UPI payment acceptance and clear payment flow guidance.
- Thermal receipt printing via Bluetooth or USB printers.
- Udhaar (credit) management with reminders and simple record-keeping.
- Daily income tracking and basic AI insights for business decisions.
- Integrations and hardware references: Bluetooth thermal printers, USB thermal printers, POS devices, QR payment sound box.

## Products, Plans and Pricing
- 30-Day Free Trial — full feature access (marketing page lists it as a starter option).
- Monthly Plan — recurring monthly subscription.
- Yearly Plan — annual subscription described as best value.

Note: the repo contains `LandingPages.tsx`, `PricingPage.tsx`, and `FeaturesPage.tsx` which hold copy and structure for pricing and feature sections.

## Technologies and architecture (from repo)
- Frontend: Next.js (app router) and React components located under `app/`.
- CMS: Strapi (site fetches metadata from endpoints such as `/api/home-meta`).
- HTTP client: Axios instance at `lib/api.ts`.
- JSON-LD generation: `app/components/JsonLd.tsx` uses `seo`, `geo`, and `aeo` metadata.

## Important public pages (paths and purpose)
- / — Marketing homepage (dynamic SEO via `getHomeMeta`) and landing sections.
- /smart-billing-lite — Product landing mirroring the homepage content.
- /smart-billing-lite/features and /features — Features overview and benefits.
- /smart-billing-lite/pricing and /pricing — Pricing comparison and plan details.
- /about-us — About page (`app/about-us/page.tsx`) describing the product and audience.
- /contact-us — Contact and support page.
- /download — APK download and related instructions.
- /blog — Blog index (`app/blog/page.tsx`) with articles.
  - /blog/why-small-businesses-need-digital-billing
  - /blog/qr-upi-payments-for-local-businesses
  - /blog/how-to-track-udhaar-without-confusion
- /privacy-policy, /terms-and-conditions, /refund-cancellation-policy, /shipping-delivery-policy — Legal pages.
- /smart-billing-lite-affiliate-program — Affiliate program landing page.

## What to NOT index or request by agents
- The `app/admin/*` routes are administrative and should not be crawled or indexed.
- User dashboards under `app/promoter`, `app/vendor`, and `app/referral` contain user-specific data (not public marketing content).

## Structured data and AEO/GEO sources
- The site uses Strapi CMS metadata endpoints which include three main blocks:
  - `seo` — metaTitle, metaDescription, canonicalUrl, shareImage
  - `geo` — AI summary, keyTakeaways, FAQs, topics, references
  - `aeo` — enableAEO flag, schemaType, headline, description, url, image, faqItems
- Example endpoints present in the codebase:
  - `/api/home-meta`
  - `/api/blog-meta`
  - `/api/feature-meta`
  - `/api/about-meta`

Agents should fetch these endpoints to obtain canonical metadata and JSON-LD building blocks.

## Blog article summaries (from `lib/blog.ts`)
- Why Small Businesses Need Digital Billing — explains time savings, error reduction, and converting sales into useful data.
- A Simple Guide to QR and UPI Payments for Local Businesses — practical tips for placing QR codes, confirming payments, and recording digital payments.
- How to Track Udhaar Without Confusion — advice on one-record-per-customer, recording partial payments, and polite follow-ups.

## FAQs (source locations)
- FAQ content is stored in `geo.faqs` for pages backed by Strapi (the `app/components/JsonLd.tsx` already maps these to an FAQPage schema when present).

## How agents should use the site to answer questions
1. Fetch metadata from the Strapi endpoints listed above to get authoritative SEO/GEO/AEO fields.
2. Use `JsonLd` schema where available to extract structured Organization, SoftwareApplication, FAQ, and WebSite entries.
3. For product-level details (features, pricing), use the `LandingPages` components and `PricingPage.tsx` content as the canonical text source.
4. For blog guidance and how-to, read the article pages generated from `lib/blog.ts`.

## Contact and business details
- The repo does not include an explicit postal address or official phone number; the About page lists service area and product focus only.
- Do not invent contact details; use the contact page on the live site for any user-facing contact information.

## Change log and maintenance hints for LLMs
- When new marketing content is added to Strapi, the endpoints mentioned earlier will return updated `seo`, `geo`, and `aeo` objects that should be consumed for AEO/GEO updates.
- JSON-LD generation is centralized in `app/components/JsonLd.tsx` — updating that file updates site-wide structured output.
